method: Cook millet components separately, finish vegetables with tempered spices, assemble as a seasonal platter.
Cook millet and moong dal until creamy; finish with ghee, black pepper, cumin and cashew.
Ferment millet batter overnight; spread thin on hot griddle and finish with pepper podi and coconut.
Marinate chicken with pepper, curry leaf and aromatics; sear and finish over high heat with charred lemon.
Build a coconut-tamarind base, simmer seasonal fish gently and finish with curry leaves.
Roast pumpkin, simmer with moong dal and finish with smoked spice tempering.
Reduce mango with coconut cream and jaggery; perfume with cardamom and roasted cashew.
Simmer tomato, tamarind and estate herbs; finish with crushed pepper and curry leaf.
